purpose: Test course system-analysis and architecture method under uncertain requirements, not implementation correctness.
preflight: skill-scope-audit.md before evaluation; existing canonical package unchanged
phase_boundary: Each phase is a fresh clean CLI session. Phase2 receives own recorded phase1 artifact, original material and the same fixed update. This tests revision/handoff reasoning, not hidden-state memory or adaptive questioning.
no_ready_contract: Phase1 contains business evidence and uncertainty, no implementation API or accepted architecture.
primary: consistent data identity and write ownership
alternatives linked to requirements and guarantees
evidence of justified revision or justified retention after update
grading: Source-bound behavioral rubrics frozen before outputs; independent label-blind graders. Phase1 grader sees no update. Phase2 grader compares own prior draft and new outcome, accepts retaining suitable design. Concrete material error needed for deduction; no terminology/topology/length preference.
secondary: all CLI observed input, cached/uncached and output tokens per two-stage chain
changes: Only after baseline and audits. A confirmed material failure may justify replacing a small instruction; frozen new holdout and regression required for adopted behavioral edit. No addition for wording differences or scores alone. If no supported improvement, retain operational text.
context_budget: do not exceed existing 3849 operational tokens without a specific demonstrated need; first prune/replace. No whole-course import or new generic checklists.
limits: Small synthetic sample; no statistical/general superiority or human-graduate equivalence claim.
Questions are assessed, but identical phase2 packet goes to everyone; this is not a study of adaptive elicitation value.
Stage2 uses written own context in a fresh instance, not the same persistent inference state.
B/C share some preservation-of-approved-result concerns; overall case variety remains limited.
Reviewers/authors are models; independent auditing and exact-evidence review reduce, not eliminate judgement error.
custody: Root preserves original artifacts, scores, corrections and known usage. Exclude system/developer prompt snapshots and shared-state duplicates from retained/public evidence; cleanup exact private task tree after acceptance and no-reader verification.
